item.title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
item.description:
This research aims to improve spatial reasoning in AI models, specifically VLM agents, by enhancing their ability to understand and navigate spatial environments. The team built a spatial memory agent that can learn from experience and improve its spatial intelligence. The result is a more effective way to enhance spatial reasoning in AI models without requiring significant retraining or external tools.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work

item.title: [News] Science One Framework: A verifiable autonomous research framework via Chain-of-Evidence
item.description: Google AI has introduced Science One Framework, a verifiable autonomous research framework called Chain-of-Evidence. This framework aims to improve the transparency and reproducibility of scientific research.

item.title: [News] Looking back on Microsoft’s FY26: From AI experimentation to Frontier Transformation
item.description: Microsoft reflects on its FY26 fiscal year, highlighting customers' progress in adopting AI for real-world business outcomes. This marks a shift from AI experimentation to deploying AI for transformative growth and innovation.

item.title: [News] Rethinking security for the age of AI
item.description: Microsoft is introducing Project Perception, a new cyber stack, in response to changing physical and virtual security needs.

item.title: [News] Powering America’s Genesis Mission: Microsoft’s commitment to scientific discovery
item.description: Microsoft has committed $60 million to support the Department of Energy's Genesis Mission, accelerating AI for science breakthroughs.

item.title: [News] DeepSeek's top-ranked V4 Flash stumbles on real agent tasks as its prices surge
item.description: DeepSeek's V4 Flash AI model, a top-ranked model on leaderboards, performed poorly on real-world agent tasks with only 53.8% success rate. This raises concerns about its potential in actual use cases.
